doctorAbout.title: About
doctorAbout.short_description: Dr. Naveen B S is a head and neck oncology specialist with expertise in managing cancers of the oral cavity, throat, thyroid, and related structures. He is skilled in complex oncologic surgeries, including organ-preserving and reconstructive procedures. With a patient-focused approach, he emphasizes early diagnosis, multidisciplinary care, and precise surgical treatment to improve outcomes and quality of life.
